exposure: Mode of delivery (repeat Cesarean section vs. vaginal birth after Cesarean section [VBAC])
cohort: 34,854 women with a previous singleton live birth who had a Cesarean section and whose infant was alive at the time of interview, from the 2004-2011 Pregnancy Risk Assessment Monitoring System
finding: Married women who had a repeat Cesarean section were more likely to never breastfeed compared to women with VBAC, while no significant association was found among non-married women.
mod_finding: Married women who had a repeat C-section were more likely to never breastfeed compared to women with vaginal birth after caesarean section (VBAC).
